evidence: Reverse-mapped all 144 criteria in per-row-review/evidence/27/criterion-map.json. F1: task/tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23 requires a requisition with "a title, a department" and :24 requires preserving "title/department". The same department-bearing creation/readback is a hard global prerequisite in scored/functional/prompt.md:9, scored/polish/prompt.md:7 and scored/visual/prompt.md:7. Public instruction.md:5 requests a usable compensation/requisition desk and leaves layout/names free; hireops_rules.md:37-39 requires Recruiter requisition creation, :179-196 defines its budget/movements, and :208-209 permits generated or entered identifiers. Neither public note nor the instruction requires a department field. The optional demonstration requisition schema contains dept, but instruction.md:11 and rules:90-96 explicitly make operational history optional. A distinct editable department is not necessary to fulfill a requisition intake or shared-storage contract. F2: scored/polish/judge.toml:32 requires that after an interrupted rescission "the valid effective date remains in an editable form". Public instruction.md:7 separately requires a failed rescission to retain its date for retry; it asks correction/editability for revision and change-set terms, not rescission-date editing. A retained date visible in a read-only operation summary with an unchanged Retry action satisfies the stated rescission recovery promise but the criterion rejects it. F3: scored/functional/judge.toml:461 adds an unconditional pre-mutation REQ-ENG-2 / 450000.00 / -200000.00 / -197000.00 / 53000.00 witness. It conflicts with public instruction.md:11 and the explicit optional-history reminder in tests/app_context.md:21 and functional/prompt.md:23. Those reminders are counterevidence against intentionally requiring import, but the criterion never makes its named-row leg conditional or supplies an equivalent created-control alternative, leaving two grading bars. The required movement-netting outcome is already supported by the P4 fresh approval and rules:179-196. These are source-level false-fail counterexamples; no configured judge was run. Other reviewed demands map to public rules: 401/403, safe integers, date precision, exact amounts, original result replay, immutable receipts and batch state transitions are expressly required; route/schema/label/ID/theme/mobile conventions are expressly disclaimed. A no-op/browser-only app cannot satisfy the independent-context fresh-record gate, and a stale-headroom implementation is rejected by the fresh movement witness; neither justifies the extra department or mandatory optional-row demands. The raw index classification explicitly reports no full configured judge/Oracle/model/ordering/timing evidence. Verified all 97 artifact hashes; this byte verification is not runtime grading.
counterexample: F1: A fully functional desk creates requisitions using generated ID, position title and annual budget, with no separate department property. Its offers, shared SQLite reads, financial rules, roles, batch changes and restart durability all conform; hro_gate_shared cannot enter/read back a department and can zero the whole reward. F2: After a genuine transport refusal, a rescission wizard retains and displays the selected effective date in a read-only confirmation view; Retry resubmits the exact date and succeeds. It conforms to retained-date retry but fails the editable-form demand. F3: An explicitly permitted empty operational start imports users/employees/constants/clock only, then correctly nets every newly created commitment and passes P4; no REQ-ENG-2 exists, so a literal all-legs reading of hro_commitment fails it despite the global optional-roster exemption. These alternatives were evaluated against source wording, not executed or assigned measured scores.
suggested_fix: F1: Keep the fresh-record shared-storage witness but require only publicly required requisition identity/budget and whatever optional descriptive fields the UI actually supports, removing mandatory department everywhere. F2: Accept any visible retained effective date plus a normal unchanged successful retry, whether shown in editable controls or a read-only retry summary. F3: Make the REQ-ENG-2 observation explicitly conditional on import, or replace it with a judge-created movement-netting control that every conforming empty desk can supply; retain the real headroom rule.
